build_DDPLoss_wrapper: build a DDP-aware loss wrapper using DDPLoss with mean or sum reduction for distributed training
create_DDPMTLoss_with_reduction: create a DDPMTLoss wrapper with per_structure reduction and a custom coefficient for molecular tasks
register_custom_loss: register a custom loss function like MAELoss or MSELoss using the registry decorator pattern
compute_per_atom_mae: compute per-atom MAE loss by dividing predictions and targets by atom counts using PerAtomMAELoss
compute_l2_norm_loss: compute L2 norm loss on vector predictions using L2NormLoss for force prediction tasks
